programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Ahead of the first North London derby of the season, we sit down with the man who made one of most controversial transfers in World football; Sol Campbell. He opens up about his decision to leave Tottenham for their fiercest rivals, Arsenal, the intense pressure of returning to White Hart Lane that first season, and how he's dealt with the fallout ever since. A fascinating insight into the 'move that shook North London'.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. programme.desc: Coverage from the 24 Hours of Le Mans, as the third round of the season takes place at Circuit de la Sarthe in Le Mans, France. This prestigious race, first held in 1923, is the oldest endurance event in the world, and is one of three races in the 'triple crown' alongside the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix and the Indycar Indianapolis 500. Legendary British driver Graham Hill is the only driver to complete the triple crown, while Fernando Alonso only needs to win the Indianapolis 500 to add his name to history.

programme.desc: Coverage from the 24 Hours of Le Mans, as the third round of the season takes place at Circuit de la Sarthe in Le Mans, France. This prestigious race, first held in 1923, is the oldest endurance event in the world, and is one of three races in the 'triple crown' alongside the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix and the Indycar Indianapolis 500. Legendary British driver Graham Hill is the only driver to complete the triple crown, while Fernando Alonso only needs to win the Indianapolis 500 to add his name to history.

Through wide-ranging interview, archive and a bespoke creative treatment, these films tell each player's individual story, their journey to stardom and the impact they could make for their nations on the world's biggest stage.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Ahead of the first North London derby of the season, we sit down with the man who made one of most controversial transfers in World football; Sol Campbell. He opens up about his decision to leave Tottenham for their fiercest rivals, Arsenal, the intense pressure of returning to White Hart Lane that first season, and how he's dealt with the fallout ever since. A fascinating insight into the 'move that shook North London'.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history.

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 2025/2026 (ARS)
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the second of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Gary Neville. A story on one of the league's most influential right-backs and a leader whose impact still shapes English football today.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way.

programme.desc: Coverage from the 24 Hours of Le Mans, as the third round of the season takes place at Circuit de la Sarthe in Le Mans, France. This prestigious race, first held in 1923, is the oldest endurance event in the world, and is one of three races in the 'triple crown' alongside the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix and the Indycar Indianapolis 500. Legendary British driver Graham Hill is the only driver to complete the triple crown, while Fernando Alonso only needs to win the Indianapolis 500 to add his name to history.

programme.desc: Coverage from the 24 Hours of Le Mans, as the third round of the season takes place at Circuit de la Sarthe in Le Mans, France. This prestigious race, first held in 1923, is the oldest endurance event in the world, and is one of three races in the 'triple crown' alongside the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix and the Indycar Indianapolis 500. Legendary British driver Graham Hill is the only driver to complete the triple crown, while Fernando Alonso only needs to win the Indianapolis 500 to add his name to history.
